name: stream-input-refused-replaying

graded_by.test: core/internal/session/reattach_test.go — client input from hello until live is not forwarded, not held, and is answered input_refused replaying

description: Input authority must not activate before the replay is complete (immortality §6.3): client input that arrives while the session's data path is being restored — from the loss of its data socket, or its hello, until live — is refused on C2 with reason replaying — never forwarded, and never held for later, because keystrokes typed while the screen still replays are how you type into the wrong prompt on a production router.
